# M5-S2: imported const func evaluation across separate modules (T-201, T-Sec6, R-U2).
# Package calc in module example.com/constlib exports const funcs that evaluate
# through private helpers, private types, private constants, and a transitive
# const function in package transitive. Results cover scalars, arrays, slices,
# structs, named exported types, and private named types consumed through
# inference and exported fields/methods. A consumer module forces compile-time
# evaluation using const declarations and a constant array bound. Native
# execution and ejected upstream-Go output maintain full parity. A plain-Go
# caller sees ordinary function semantics when driven with logos.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# 1. Consumer module evaluates imported const funcs at compile time.
cd consumer
logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/want.txt
stdout '^closed: 25$'
stdout '^bound: 32$'
stdout '^score: 200$'
stdout '^array: 10 11 12$'
stdout '^slice: 3 6 9$'
stdout '^matrix: 2 3 grid$'
stdout '^summary: 50 batch 100 batch!$'
stdout '^table-len: 32$'

# 2. Eject consumer module to plain Go and verify parity.
logos eject -o ../eject_out
exists ../eject_out/main.go
cd ../eject_out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
cd ../consumer
cd ..

# 3. Plain Go caller module sees ordinary function semantics, driven with logos.
cd gocaller
logos run .
stdout '^gocaller: 25 32 1 4 plain-go 7 14$'
cd ..

-- lib/go.mod --
module example.com/constlib

go 1.27

-- lib/transitive/transitive.lgo --
package transitive

// Step is a transitive const function in a third package.
const func Step(x int) int {
	return x * 10
}

-- lib/calc/calc.lgo --
package calc

import "example.com/constlib/transitive"

// Private constant, private type, and private helper forming a closure.
const privateBase = 10

type privateFactor int

const func privateHelper(x int, f privateFactor) int {
	return x*int(f) + privateBase
}

// ComputeClosed is an exported const func evaluated through a private helper closure.
const func ComputeClosed(x int) int {
	return privateHelper(x, privateFactor(3))
}

// TransitiveCompute calls a transitive const function in package transitive.
const func TransitiveCompute(x int) int {
	return transitive.Step(x) + privateHelper(x, privateFactor(1))
}

// Score is a named exported scalar type for exact named constant arithmetic.
type Score int64

const (
	BaseScore   Score = 100
	ScaleFactor Score = 4
)

const func ScoreMath(s Score) Score {
	return s*ScaleFactor + BaseScore
}

// MakeArray produces an observable array result.
const func MakeArray(seed int) [3]int {
	return [3]int{seed, seed + 1, seed + 2}
}

// MakeSlice produces an observable slice result.
const func MakeSlice(start int) []int {
	return []int{start, start * 2, start * 3}
}

// Matrix is a named exported struct result type.
type Matrix struct {
	Row int
	Col int
	Tag string
}

const func MakeMatrix(r, c int, tag string) Matrix {
	return Matrix{Row: r, Col: c, Tag: tag}
}

// privateSummary is a private named struct result type.
type privateSummary struct {
	Total int
	Kind  string
}

func (s privateSummary) Twice() int {
	return s.Total * 2
}

func (s privateSummary) Desc() string {
	return s.Kind + "!"
}

// Summarize returns a private named result consumed through inference/methods.
const func Summarize(total int, kind string) privateSummary {
	return privateSummary{Total: total, Kind: kind}
}

-- consumer/go.mod --
module example.com/consumer

go 1.27

require example.com/constlib v0.0.0

replace example.com/constlib => ../lib

-- consumer/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/constlib/calc"
)

// Const initializers force compile-time evaluation of imported const funcs.
const (
	ClosedVal  = calc.ComputeClosed(5)
	ArrayBound = calc.TransitiveCompute(2) // 2*10 + (2*1 + 10) = 32
	ScoreVal   = calc.ScoreMath(25)        // 25*4 + 100 = 200
	ArrayVal   = calc.MakeArray(10)        // [10, 11, 12]
	SliceVal   = calc.MakeSlice(3)         // [3, 6, 9]
	MatrixVal  = calc.MakeMatrix(2, 3, "grid")
	SummaryVal = calc.Summarize(50, "batch")
)

// Constant array bound forces compile-time integer constant requirement.
type FixedTable [ArrayBound]byte

func main() {
	var tbl FixedTable

	// Verify named exported result type preservation and func signatures.
	var _ func(calc.Score) calc.Score = calc.ScoreMath
	var _ func(int, int, string) calc.Matrix = calc.MakeMatrix
	var m calc.Matrix = MatrixVal

	// Verify private named result consumed through inference and exported fields/methods.
	s := SummaryVal
	sTotal := s.Total
	sKind := s.Kind
	sTwice := s.Twice()
	sDesc := s.Desc()

	// Named constant arithmetic result type preservation.
	var sc calc.Score = ScoreVal

	fmt.Println("closed:", ClosedVal)
	fmt.Println("bound:", ArrayBound)
	fmt.Println("score:", int64(sc))
	fmt.Println("array:", ArrayVal[0], ArrayVal[1], ArrayVal[2])
	fmt.Println("slice:", SliceVal[0], SliceVal[1], SliceVal[2])
	fmt.Println("matrix:", m.Row, m.Col, m.Tag)
	fmt.Println("summary:", sTotal, sKind, sTwice, sDesc)
	fmt.Println("table-len:", len(tbl))
}

-- gocaller/go.mod --
module example.com/gocaller

go 1.27

require example.com/constlib v0.0.0

replace example.com/constlib => ../lib

-- gocaller/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/constlib/calc"
)

func main() {
	// A Go importer sees calc.ComputeClosed as an ordinary function
	// (SPEC T-201, T-Sec6, R-U2).
	var _ func(int) int = calc.ComputeClosed
	var _ func(int, int, string) calc.Matrix = calc.MakeMatrix
	var _ func(calc.Score) calc.Score = calc.ScoreMath

	c := calc.ComputeClosed(5)
	t := calc.TransitiveCompute(2)
	m := calc.MakeMatrix(1, 4, "plain-go")
	s := calc.Summarize(7, "go")
	fmt.Println("gocaller:", c, t, m.Row, m.Col, m.Tag, s.Total, s.Twice())
}
